name: traneai-extension
description: TraneAI - VS Code Extension with Backend API

scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:backend & sleep 3 && (code --new-window traneai-frontend & sleep 2 && xdotool key F5 2>/dev/null || echo 'xdotool not installed, press F5 manually')
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.clean: npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd traneai_backend && npm install && cd ../traneai-frontend && npm install
